hooks.name: codelux-memory
hooks.description: Codelux: project memory in context at session start; refreshes the AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md block

hooks.name: codelux-session
hooks.description: Codelux: session code and usage tracking (silent)

hooks.name: codelux-prompt-memory
hooks.description: Codelux: relevant memory for this prompt as additionalContext (nothing when nothing is found)

hooks.name: codelux-session-prompt
hooks.description: Codelux: count the prompt; rarely one hint about the last turn

hooks.name: codelux-lock-acquire
hooks.description: Codelux: take the file lock (local + Team) before an edit; exit 2 with the reason when refused

hooks.name: codelux-session-pre
hooks.description: Codelux: start of every tool call for the procedure trace, file read (path+hash), MCP call announcement; rarely one hint as additionalContext

hooks.name: codelux-lock-release
hooks.description: Codelux: release the file lock after an edit

hooks.name: codelux-session-post
hooks.description: Codelux: one row of the procedure trace (tool, essential arguments, response size, duration; never contents)

hooks.name: codelux-session-stop
hooks.description: Codelux: read the new usage numbers (silent)

hooks.name: codelux-session-end
hooks.description: Codelux: close the task and write the usage report (silent)
